title: One Number in a URL Exposed Patients' Medical Reports
description: No clever hacking. I looked at a lab report URL, changed one number, and another patient's report opened without a login.

title: How I Hacked PickMe Fare
description: I followed two ordinary route metrics through PickMe's Android app, changed a controlled fare estimate, responsibly reported the issue, and watched it get fixed.

title: What I Found Inside a Famous ePassbook App in Sri Lanka
description: I opened a banking Android APK to practise reverse engineering. One small search led me through broken TLS checks, embedded credentials, local encryption, logs, and a weak request encryption format.
